Plot an ordination

Source: R/fct_plot.R
plot_ordination.Rd

Plot an ordination

Usage

plot_ordination(
  ord,
  groups = NULL,
  group_title = "Group",
  axes = c(1, 2),
  labels = FALSE,
  ellipses = TRUE,
  tooltip = NULL,
  dark = FALSE
)

Arguments

ord

A cl_ord from ordinate().

groups

Optional named vector of groups for colour.

group_title

Legend title.

axes

Which two axes to plot.

labels

Show sample names.

ellipses

Draw 95% ellipses for groups with at least four samples.

tooltip

Optional named character vector of hover text.

dark

Colours for a dark background.

Value

A ggplot object.
